subject: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options (post-call)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options (post-call)

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call plus the next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call recap:
- Use case: real-time extraction + summarization for product analytics dashboards.
- Current pilot: 2M tokens/day, expects to ramp to ~10M tokens/day over 6 months.
- Primary requirements: predictable latency (<250ms tail for 99th), audit logs, and unit economics visibility.

Open asks we called out on the call:
1) Confirm expected token volumes (daily/monthly) and expected ramp timeline (you mentioned 2M -> 10M/day).
2) Target $/1M tokens you need to hit budget targets (you mentioned wanting to land around a specific $/1M).
3) Procurement timeline and any PO/contract constraints (procurement contact if different than you).

What I promised on the call:
- Draft committed-use pricing options (12/24-month tiers), plus on-demand comparison and multi-year incentives.
- Attach the committed-use tier PDF, startup program T&Cs (in case you qualify), and a Mutual Action Plan template.

Next steps / ask from you:
- Confirm whether Finlytics would consider a committed-use contract (monthly committed tokens or $ commit) and your preferred commitment window (12 vs 24 months).
- Share procurement contact (I cc'd procurement in case that's the right inbox).

I'll follow up tomorrow with concrete numbers and a couple of scenarios (initial and ramp). If convenient, can we schedule a 30-min follow-up on Tue or Wed to walk through the numbers and a draft MSA?

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_CommittedUse_Tiers.pdf, Startup_Discount_T&Cs.docx, Finlytics_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:05:12 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options (post-call)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that looks right. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Volumes: initial pilot ~2M tokens/day (peak), production ramp to ~10M tokens/day over ~6 months. That translates to ~60M tokens/month initial and ~300M/month at full ramp.
- Budget: we are targeting roughly $20k–$50k/month for the first 6 months but expect to increase materially after product-market fit.
- Target unit economics: we'd like to see ~$800–$1,200 per 1M tokens (ballpark) to make unit economics work on our side. If committed-use or prepay changes that delta materially, happy to consider.

Procurement is looped here. Their key asks: 
- Do you offer committed monthly minimums in tokens or dollar-commit?
- Any discounts for upfront prepay vs monthly billing?

If you can put together 2–3 scenarios with concrete $/1M and example monthly bills at 60M and 300M tokens, that will help us decide which path to take.

Best,
Michael
Michael Chen
VP Product, Finlytics
michael.chen@finlytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options (post-call)

Marissa / Aditya —

Nice call. Quick thoughts on pricing options we can present that are realistic vs margin and that map to the ask (~$800–$1,200 / 1M):
- On-demand (no commitment): $1,500 / 1M tokens. Good for flexibility; unit economics are worse.
- 12-month committed-use (monthly billing against a committed token baseline): 25% off on-demand = $1,125 / 1M. Requires a monthly commit; overages billed at on-demand.
- 24-month committed-use (prepay or monthly billed): 35% off = $975 / 1M. We can add an extra 5% if they prepay 12 months upfront (i.e., 40% total).

Notes: 
- If they sign a 12mo commit at a sufficiently large baseline (e.g., 200M tokens/month avg over year), the $/1M moves closer to their target band.
- Startup program: 50% off first 6 months up to $10k/month credit — only for companies that qualify. Finlytics probably doesn't qualify, but worth asking (Ben: can we make a special intro discount as a one-time incentive?).

I'll draft the numbers and a short MA P with milestones so procurement has something to review.

Ben
Ben Carter | Sales Director
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@finlytics.com>, Procurement <procurement@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:15:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options (post-call)

Hi Michael / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick feedback. Attached are three concrete scenarios per your request (see attachments): On-demand, 12-mo commit, 24-mo commit. Below is a short summary and example monthly bills at both 60M and 300M tokens/month so you can see the delta.

Pricing summary (per 1M tokens):
- On-demand: $1,500 / 1M
- 12-month committed (monthly billing against committed baseline): $1,125 / 1M (25% off)
- 24-month committed (prepay or monthly billed): $975 / 1M (35% off). Additional 5% if they prepay 12 months upfront (total 40% off).

Example monthly cost (60M/month initial):
- On-demand: 60 * $1,500 = $90,000/month
- 12-mo commit: 60 * $1,125 = $67,500/month
- 24-mo commit: 60 * $975 = $58,500/month

Example monthly cost (300M/month ramp):
- On-demand: 300 * $1,500 = $450,000/month
- 12-mo commit: 300 * $1,125 = $337,500/month
- 24-mo commit: 300 * $975 = $292,500/month

Startup program note: if Finlytics qualifies (early-stage, limited revenue), there is a startup program that can provide up to 50% off for the first 6 months (capped at $10k/month credit). Based on our quick check, it doesn't look like Finlytics meets the startup program criteria, but we can confirm if you'd like us to run the qualification.

Multi-year incentive: we can offer an additional 5% off the committed price for a 24-month agreement if Finlytics prepays 12 months (applies to the committed baseline).

Attachments included: Redwood_CommittedUse_Tiers.pdf (breakdown of tiers & overage rules), Startup_Discount_T&Cs.docx (program criteria), Finlytics_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (milestones, owners, and timelines).

Proposed next steps:
1) Let us know which scenario you'd like to move forward with (on-demand vs 12mo vs 24mo).
2) If committed, please provide a target monthly committed token baseline or target monthly $commit so we can build contract language and a draft SOW.
3) If procurement has standard terms, share those; otherwise we'll propose Redwood's MSA and add the committed-use schedule.

Would you be available for a 30-min call Wed 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET to walk the numbers?

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_CommittedUse_Tiers.pdf, Startup_Discount_T&Cs.docx, Finlytics_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx
